title: Consecutive reduction for normalized integral scalar tensor maps
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, let $E,L/\mathbf Q_\ell$ be finite extensions and $\iota:E\to L$ an embedding. Use the specified ordinary scalar-extension functors $S_W$ [def-weil-integral-scalar-extension] and finite operation functors [lem-pur-integral-operations-well-defined]. For a scheme $W$, let $T^E_n,T^L_n$ be the finite total-tensor functors with the recorded consecutive transitions $r^E_n,r^L_n$. Suppose $\alpha_n:S_W T^E_n\to T^L_n(S_W\times S_W)$ are natural chain maps whose action on each bidegree generator is $1\otimes((1\otimes x)\otimes(1\otimes y))\mapsto  (1\otimes(1\otimes x))\otimes(1\otimes(1\otimes y))$. Then, for every $n$, $S_W(r^E_n);\alpha_n=\alpha_{n+1};r^L_n(S_W\times S_W)$. This is only the consecutive reduction equation; it asserts neither existence nor uniqueness of a map on whole towers.

source.place: Section tensor-product, including lemma-sheafification-tensor and lemma-tensor-product-pullback; finite quotient transition argument in Bhatt--Scholze Definition 3.4.10 and Stacks 07A4.

proof.text: In each total degree use the ordinary scalar adjunction from ScalarExtensionComposition to test equality after the unit. For the finite total tensor use the generator-normalized finiteTensorComparison from the strict tensor reduction comparison. Precompose with this isomorphism and apply total_extension_hom_ext from IntegralTensorTransitionCompatibility; scalar extension and restriction preserve the summand coproducts. Lift each finite coefficient section along the completed projection: constantQuotient_surjective gives a lift to the constant integer sheaf, and the constant-to-completion map gives the required completed section. The balanced tensor relation moves this lifted coefficient onto the first original input. The normalized finite comparison therefore reduces the equality to the displayed coefficient-one generators. All three auxiliary statements in this argument are proved private helpers, without new obligations.

On an original pair of sections, scalarAdjunction_unit identifies the testing map with integralOrdinaryTensorSection at coefficient one. Apply scalar_map_tensor, the chosen tensor transition formula, and the chosen ordinary reduction formula. Ring maps preserve one, so h_alpha at level n identifies the first route. Apply h_alpha at n+1 to the second route and then the L-coefficient tensor and ordinary reduction formulas. The results coincide definitionally. HomologicalComplex.hom_ext and NatTrans.ext assemble these equalities in every degree and at every pair of input complexes.

proof_origin.place: Section tensor-product, lemma-sheafification-tensor and lemma-tensor-product-pullback; direct-sum total tensor and finite quotient transition calculation. Reuses existing proved normalized comparisons and extensionality helpers; no further split.

theorem integralScalarTensorLevelReduction (W : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u})
    (α : ∀ n : ℕ, integralOperationsTensorLevel l E W n ⋙
        (integralOrdinaryScalar l E L ι W).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⟶
      ((integralOrdinaryScalar l E L ι W).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).prod
        ((integralOrdinaryScalar l E L ι W).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) ⋙
          integralOperationsTensorLevel l L W n)
    (hα : ∀ (n : ℕ) (P Q : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E W) ℤ) (p q : ℤ)
        (U : W.ProEtᵒᵖ) (x : (P.X p).val.obj U) (y : (Q.X q).val.obj U),
        (((α n).app (P, Q)).f (p + q)).val.app U
          (integralOrdinaryTensorSection l E L ι W
            (((integralOperationsTensorLevel l E W n).obj (P, Q)).X (p + q)) U 1
            (integralOperationsTotalTensorSection l E W n P Q p q U
              (unrestrictedIntegralTensorSection l E W n (P.X p) U 1 x)
              (unrestrictedIntegralTensorSection l E W n (Q.X q) U 1 y))) =
        integralOperationsTotalTensorSection l L W n
          (((integralOrdinaryScalar l E L ι W).mapHomologicalComplex
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj P)
          (((integralOrdinaryScalar l E L ι W).mapHomologicalComplex
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj Q) p q U
          (unrestrictedIntegralTensorSection l L W n
            ((integralOrdinaryScalar l E L ι W).obj (P.X p)) U 1
            (integralOrdinaryTensorSection l E L ι W (P.X p) U 1 x))
          (unrestrictedIntegralTensorSection l L W n
            ((integralOrdinaryScalar l E L ι W).obj (Q.X q)) U 1
            (integralOrdinaryTensorSection l E L ι W (Q.X q) U 1 y))) (n : ℕ) :
    Functor.whiskerRight (integralOperationsTensorTransition l E W n)
        ((integralOrdinaryScalar l E L ι W).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) ≫
      α n =
    α (n + 1) ≫ Functor.whiskerLeft
      (((integralOrdinaryScalar l E L ι W).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).prod
        ((integralOrdinaryScalar l E L ι W).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)))
      (integralOperationsTensorTransition l L W n)
